## Download

| OS | File |
|---|---|
| **Windows** | `Heyo_…_x64-setup.exe` (installer) or `…_x64_en-US.msi` |
| **macOS** (Apple Silicon) | `Heyo_…_aarch64.dmg` |
| **macOS** (Intel) | `Heyo_…_x64.dmg` |
| **Linux** | `.AppImage`, `.deb` or `.rpm` |

The builds are not code-signed yet:

- **Windows**: SmartScreen may warn you. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
- **macOS**: right-click the app → **Open** the first time, then allow Heyo in System Settings → Privacy & Security → **Accessibility**.

To use your Claude subscription, install [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) and run `claude` once to sign in. Or paste an Anthropic API key in Settings → General.

See the [README](https://github.com/clixmods/heyo#readme) for everything else.
